shared_elements: bearded male heads with elaborately rendered hair/beard in rows of curls
procession or file of figures moving in one direction
low relief with figures on a ground line
hands holding objects (reins/weapons vs staffs/hands clasped)
long garments with incised drapery folds
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile, low relief, with stylised curled hair/beard and patterned garments, and both organise the figures along a ground line facing largely one way, which is a real conventional correspondence. However A shows a dynamic narrative scene of a horse-drawn chariot with archers over a water/reed landscape, while B is a static file of standing attendants framed above and below by rosette bands — the relationships (riding, driving, shooting vs. walking and holding hands/staffs) and the framing motifs differ substantially.
